budget_contrast_d99.definition: per instance, (emulator falsely accepts minus the perfect emulator falsely accepts) at 1,000 evaluations minus the same at budget 1 (one logged plan), on the same instance (paired by instance key; same instances and clusters at both budgets); the mean over instances (contrast); excess_at_1000 and excess_at_1: the excess at each budget
budget_contrast_d99.interval: hpr_dream.stats.excess of the per-instance contrasts against zero: cluster bootstrap over start-state families, 2000 resamples, seed 0; BCa where defined, else percentile (interval_kind); contrast holds both (lo/hi percentile, bca_lo/bca_hi BCa)
